diagnosis: The clinical lab report handler executes a query via Bun's native SQL driver fetching lab results by reportId without checking that report.patient_id matches req.patient.id. Any patient logged into the portal can view confidential pathology reports, HIV tests, genetic markers, and physician notes belonging to any other patient.
